title: OrderedTokenTask
description: Matches Kotlin OrderedTokenTask(id, prompt, tokens[], acceptedSequences[][], feedbackCorrect?, feedbackIncorrect?) / TokenOccurrence(occurrenceId, text). Reused both as an 'ordered_tokens' Activity's task and inside a Listening activity's EvaluableTask comprehension check. Token identity is the occurrence id (not the token text) so repeated words are addressable; accepted sequences are explicit occurrence-id permutations, never fuzzy text matching.
